title: A nonabelian triple system makes counting #P-hard: the r = 2 dichotomy
claim: for p >= 5 and a graded nilpotent Lie algebra n over F_p of class at most 4 with a graded involution theta (N = exp(n), G = N x| C2): if [[n-, n-], n-] != 0, counting maps from pi1 of 2-surgeries on knots (H1 = Z/2) into G is #P-hard. Proof: layered count with one J-dual form per minus component; one-parameter-subgroup bases; steering in class at most 4 (the minus part of the conjugator value is the degree-3 Lie part of the cable conjugators on all free minus classes, every correction has the trivial character); the gadget of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001C; an integer even edge weight f_B with 0 < f_B(0, s*) < f_B(0) whenever B != 0; Bulatov-Grohe on f_B^2 by edge doubling. With TRIPLE-SYSTEM-20261027-001A: at r = 2, for graded algebras of class at most 4 and closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0 and bounded 2-rank, counting is polynomial iff the Lie triple system n- is abelian, and #P-hard otherwise.
failure_conditions: A conjugator of P4 or P4B whose degree-3 Magnus part is not (1/3) of the Dynkin bracket sum, or W_0^(3) of P4 different from -[X1, [X2, X3]].
A test algebra on which g -> exp(c(g) A) theta^psi(g) fails to be a homomorphism on Aff(F_p).
A nonabelian test algebra without s* making <B(., ., .), s*> nonzero, or a count #{(pi2, pi3) : <B(pi2, pi3, .), s*> = 0} equal to p^(2d); an abelian test algebra with B != 0.
Experiment TRIPLE-SYSTEM-20261027-001B-E001 not supported, or ticket A not Proved.
foundation_claim_scope: p >= 5; graded nilpotent Lie algebras of class at most 4 with a graded involution (r = 2); hardness on 2-surgeries of knots, polynomial side (ticket A) on closed 3-manifolds with H1(M; F_p) = 0 and bounded 2-rank. Cited, not reproved: Bulatov-Grohe (Cai-Chen-Lu Thm 2.1); the Lazard correspondence and BCH to degree 4; Dynkin-Specht-Wever; the J-duality, gadget and count identity of BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001C. Not covered: class 5 and higher; non-graded algebras whose gr-triple system is abelian but whose triple system is not; p = 2, 3; r > 2; p-torsion in H1; knot exteriors. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: the Dynkin form of the degree-3 parts of the P4 and P4B conjugators and W_0^(3) = -[X1, [X2, X3]]; one-parameter subgroups as homomorphisms on Aff(F_p) for nine algebras at p = 5, 7; B nonzero with an s* for six nonabelian algebras, the Lemma 5.2 count strictly below p^(2d) where enumerable (u4: 30625 = 25 x 1225, reproducing the previous epic), B = 0 for the abelian ones; experiment B supported and ticket A Proved; no human or external review
